description_en: :books: collection of JavaScript and TypeScript data structures and algorithms for education purposes. Source code bundle of JavaScript algorithms and data structures book
readme_excerpt: Learning JavaScript Data Structures and Algorithms Project Structure You can find the source code organized by chapter under the src folder. Each file has the .js and the .ts extension, so you get both the JavaScript and the Typescript versions of the source code. Each data structure and algorithm from parts 2 and 3 also have a test folder where you can find the respective Jest test cases.
